response.overview: Max Taylor was on a clear path to a dream career in the National Hockey League. His dream ended in one game where he sustained two concussions and was stretchered off the ice on oxygen. Through Max, we see an uncompromising, gritty, and science-based look at how hockey culture, and the stigma that it perpetuates, is contributing to a concussion and mental health epidemic.
response.title: A Dark Room
